exact_reasons: Only three outer folds were created although at least five were required.
Development sample contained only 107 trades — below the 200 minimum.
Only one SHORT trade occurred in the entire development WFO — direction not meaningfully supported.
Most stress scenarios were not executed — reports contain notes/proxies instead of actual results.
Principal runtime parity was not implemented — no test invoking actual run_forward_shadow_cycle() and actual historical replay without mocks.
Actual shadow runner was not repaired — still contains hard-coded safe-state values and imports automatic calibration generation.
GitHub Actions did not succeed — jobs fail with 0 steps (infrastructure issue).
Report values do match committed fold provenance (verified), but the verdict is weak due to insufficient sample size and incomplete closure.
statement: The P2.5.1 verdict TRUTH_ENGINE_PASS_BASELINE_EDGE_WEAK is invalidated because: (1) only 3 of 5 required folds were created, (2) only 107 trades is below the 200 minimum, (3) only 1 SHORT trade is insufficient, (4) stress tests were not executed, (5) runtime parity was not implemented, (6) shadow runner was not repaired, (7) CI did not pass. The fold-specific training pipeline and cross-fitted meta-labeling implementation were correct, but the sprint is incomplete.
